summary: You may feel more attracted to what actually suits you than to what you are supposed to want.
body: You may feel more attracted to what actually suits you than to what you are supposed to want. Venus trine Lilith can make relationships, style, pleasure, money, and personal taste less dependent on outside approval for a moment. Choose the person you enjoy being around, the clothes you will actually wear, the price you are willing to pay, or the arrangement that feels fair to you. Being accepted for a preference is useful information. It is not the same thing as being compatible everywhere else.
